第39章 网抑云教父-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“抱一抱就当作从没有在一起

好不好要解释都已经来不及

算了吧我付出过什么没关系

我忽略自己就因为遇见你

没办法好可怕那个我不像话......”

《说散就散》的原唱是陈泳彤，流传度最广的却是袁娅维版本。

翻唱比原唱更火。

这在音乐界不是新鲜事。

就像凭借《封神》翻红的费翔，很多人知道他是因为《冬天里的一把火》

可谁又知道，这首歌的原唱不是费翔，而是高凌风。

这位高凌风后来还客串了《爱情公寓第二季》，在里面饰演《谁能成为百万富翁》主持人。

不管是袁娅维还是陈泳彤，她们都是女歌手，天生比男歌手嗓门亮。

原主的声音是偏低音的中音区，带着点细沙似的颗粒感，却不粗糙。

唱“抱一抱”的时候，魏沐特意用气息包裹着字音，营造出‘欲言又止’的倾诉感。

最后收尾‘而答案很简单’的时候，突然转为实声，这样可以突出‘答案’的残酷性。

控制台前，李雨春和张亚冬戴着耳机，人手拿着一份歌词。

他们的目光全部被录制歌曲的魏沐吸引。

很难想象这是一位二十二岁的大学毕业生。

“张老师。”

摘下耳机，一头短发，气质偏中性的春哥看向了自己的制作人。

“他真是上戏表演系的学生？”

“怎么了？不相信。”

张亚冬笑着回道。

一开始，他也不相信，可有的人就是这样，普通人难以完成的事情，对他们来说就想吃饭喝水一样简单。

李雨春不是普通人，人家是正经科班出身，毕业于川省音乐学院。

2005年通过《超级女声》出道，从此火遍全国。

芒果台的综艺节目经常被爆黑幕，但是这一届超级女声非常有含金量。

冠亚季军分别被李雨春，周笔唱，张靓影获得。

能够力压周笔唱和张靓影，李雨春绝不是单单靠着中性风格取胜，她唱歌台风不错，有欧美歌手的影子。

可现在，李雨春碰到了真正的高手。

她必须承认，公司新签约的艺人比她强。

不仅强在创作能力上，还有唱功和气场。

她在22岁的时候，可没有这种水平。

Chapter 39 The Godfather of Net Yiyun - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a Happy Breakup"

"Just give me a hug and pretend we've never been together.

It's too late to explain whether it's good or not.

Forget it, it doesn't matter what I paid

I ignored myself just because I met you

There’s no way it’s so scary, I’m so shameless…”

The original singer of "Let's Break Up" is Chen Yongtong, but the most widely circulated version is Yuan Yawei's version.

The cover is more popular than the original.

This is nothing new in the music industry.

Just like Fei Xiang, who became famous with "Fengshen", many people know him because of "A Fire in Winter"

But who knew that the original singer of this song was not Fei Xiang, but Gao Lingfeng.

Gao Lingfeng later made a guest appearance in "Love Apartment Season 2", where he played the host of "Who Can Be a Millionaire".

Whether it is Yuan Yawei or Chen Yongtong, they are both female singers who are born with brighter voices than male singers.

The original owner's voice is a low-pitched mid-range, with a grainy texture like fine sand, but not rough.

When singing "Hug Me", Wei Mu deliberately wrapped the sound of the words with his breath, creating a sense of confiding that "you can't speak but can't".

When it ends with 'And the answer is simple', it suddenly switches to real sound, which can highlight the cruelty of the 'answer'.

In front of the console, Li Yuchun and Zhang Yadong were wearing headphones, each holding a copy of the lyrics.

Their eyes were all attracted to Wei Mu who was recording the song.

It’s hard to imagine that this is a twenty-two-year-old college graduate.

"Teacher Zhang."

Taking off his headphones, Brother Chun, who had short hair and a neutral temperament, looked at his producer.

"Is he really a student of the drama department?"

"What's wrong? I don't believe it."

Zhang Yadong replied with a smile.

At first, he didn't believe it, but some people were like this. Things that were difficult for ordinary people to accomplish were as simple as eating and drinking.

Li Yuchun is not an ordinary person. He comes from a serious academic background and graduated from the Sichuan Conservatory of Music.

She made her debut through "Super Girl" in 2005 and has become popular all over the country.

Mango Channel's variety shows are often exposed, but this Super Girl is very valuable.

The first, second and third place were won by Li Yuchun, Zhou Bishang and Zhang Liangying respectively.

Being able to beat Zhou Bi Sing and Zhang Liangying, Li Yuchun won by no means just relying on her neutral style. She has a good singing style and has the shadow of European and American singers.

But now, Li Yuchun met a real master.

She must admit that the new artists signed by the company are better than her.

Not only is he strong in creative ability, but also in singing skills and aura.

When she was 22 years old, she didn't have this level.
